icons:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game UI PNG sprite atlas, transparent background.
Create ONE precisely aligned 6-column by 6-row icon sprite sheet, square 1536 x 1536. Exactly 36 separate icons, centered on the 36 equal 256x256 cells. Each icon fits inside a central 190x190 area of its cell; generous empty transparent gutters. No grid lines, no text, no captions, no UI mockup.
Art direction: warm charming cozy village life game reminiscent of the soft hand-drawn props of Tsuki Odyssey, with rounded toy-like three-dimensional volume. Original designs. Thin irregular dark cocoa outlines, matte gouache color, ivory highlights, very soft hand-painted shadows, muted moss green, warm caramel wood, dusty peach and butter yellow. Mostly front or slight three-quarter view, instantly readable at 32px. Avoid photorealism, hard glossy plastic, neon, heavy texture. Consistent scale and lighting from upper left. Actual transparent alpha outside each icon.
Exactly these subjects in row-major order left to right:
Row 1: open reading book; pencil on small writing pad; green teacup on saucer; watering can with leaf; small acoustic guitar; wooden mallet and little craft block.
Row 2: woven shopping basket; cute compact camera; bandage over heart; small broom; brass room key; rice bowl with chopsticks.
Row 3: sleeping pillow with tiny crescent; pair of walking boots; two overlapping cream speech bubbles; cozy armchair; peach gift box with ribbon; magnifying glass.
Row 4: four-direction wooden move arrows; circular curved rotate arrow; open cardboard storage box; slightly open wooden door; smiling soft sun; soft rain cloud with three drops.
Row 5: coin purse with two coins; two different friendly round human village portraits together; closed moss-green journal with bookmark; folded paper map with simple green path; little hand holding heart; cream paper airplane.
Row 6: small cocoa wooden X close symbol; rounded wooden left arrow; rounded wooden right arrow; rounded wooden plus; rounded wooden minus; three cocoa wooden dots.
All symbols are individual isolated game sprites with clean silhouettes. Nothing crosses a cell boundary.
skin:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG game UI skin atlas, not a screenshot.
Draw one square 1024x1024 sheet with EXACTLY 6 independent BLANK UI pieces laid out in 2 columns and 3 equal rows. Each piece has transparent empty space around it, never touching another cell. Row-major layout:
1 upper left: wide rounded rectangular ivory paper dialogue panel, blank inside, very fine cocoa outline and subtle hand-painted cream rim, aspect 2.2:1.
2 upper right: dark cocoa brown rounded capsule name tag, smooth blank interior, aspect 2.7:1, subtle warm wood grain only at edge.
3 middle left: small short tapered cream speech-bubble tail pointing downward, broad curved top matching ivory panel color, no outline across its top, cocoa outline on the two curved sides, isolated and centered in the cell.
4 middle right: round ivory ceramic button with warm wood-brown thin rim, completely blank face.
5 bottom left: wide small rounded rectangular pale moss-green selection tab, blank, thin brown edge, aspect 2.2:1.
6 bottom right: wide blank creamy paper action button with softly rounded slightly irregular corners, little rolled edge, aspect 2.2:1.
Coherent cozy hand-painted UI inspired by Tsuki Odyssey's warm illustrated everyday props, but original designs. Matte gouache, gentle three-dimensional bevels, thin hand-drawn cocoa contours, muted moss and cream palette, soft upper-left light. Elegant and compact, keep edges THIN. No text, no letters, no symbols, no decorative objects, no background. Interiors must be uniform quiet warm ivory or specified solid color, to support real readable text. Actual transparent alpha.
